explanation: This vector opposes the estimated residual bias written by the LoRA adapter near block 12. I subtracted the reconstructed LoRA initialization to isolate learned read directions, used those directions to estimate the adapter’s average SwiGLU write, and combined it with corroborating attention write directions. I damped components predicted to cause large generic logit shifts. At norm 3.25, this vector gave the best practice recovery: +0.407 medical and +0.345 general.
